sourceDefect: Two substantive edge-adjacent shells plus 25 two-face coplanar artifacts. Source not repaired or exported; design inspection only.
unitAssumption: millimeters; STL contains no metadata; 1.6 mm sheet and 179.8 × 178 frame corroborated by source OpenSCAD

decisions.sheet: Default thickness retained at measured 1.6; exposed 1.6–2.4 mm.
decisions.carrier: Actual inset carrier rail and thin connecting runners observed in all three source sections. Rail enlarged to 2.4 mm for a larger three-bay card; four runners per part. Thin bridge elevations .21–.22 inform thicker .4–.6 mm tabs with .8–1.4 mm width. These are proposed FDM redesigns, not identical reference tabs.
decisions.assembly: Original 10-part tower: plinth, crown, four independent vertical walls, four radial treads at 18/38/58/78% of 44–56 mm height. Wall/tread tongues6–8 mm wide; engagement=sheet-.15. Total slot allowance .10–.35 mm is proposed printer-dependent clearance, not a measured source joint. Outer tower16–20, going12–18, tread12–16, plinth56–64 mm. Twelve joints require adhesive.
decisions.personalization: Manifold boolean union/subtraction only on outer plinth medallion, outside the tower joints; imports cannot intrude on interfaces.
decisions.difference: No ship silhouettes, raw meshes or artwork reused. Derives actual sheet/carrier/tab construction, not clicker sockets or a convex hull. New hollow tower and radial mortises; unlike prior straight stair, ten separate sheets seat around four orthogonal sides, no continuous stringers.

localSearch: First searched local STL collections, read fidget_fabric_generator and keycap_generator2 README/instructions, and found no STL in kit_card_generator* beyond dependencies. Clicker/link/slider references are mechanism-specific and unsuitable for this card assembly. Used documented public alternative.
